title: Maths words that mean add or take away
examples: What does altogether mean in maths?
What does left mean in a maths question?

explain.say: Maths stories often have clue words. A clue word can tell you what to do. Look at the 2 groups on the board. One group means add. The other group means take away.

draw.text: Maths words that mean add or take away

explain.say: Look at the add words: add, plus, altogether, in total, sum. They mean putting things together. Altogether means all of them added up. Can you bring your hands together for add?
Now look at the take away words: take away, minus, left, fewer, difference. They mean some things go, or you compare. Left means what is still there. Can you move your hands apart for take away?
Here is a story. Sam has 6 pens. Lola has 2 pens. How many pens do they have altogether? Altogether usually means add. 6 and 2 make 8.

Here is one more. There are 7 birds. 3 birds fly away. How many are left? Here, left means take away. 7 take away 3 is 4. Always check what happens in the story too. Today, find a clue word in a maths story.

faq.a: Altogether means all the things added up. If you have 6 pens and 2 more pens, altogether you have 8.
asks: Tell me about the add words

faq.q: What does left mean in a maths story?
faq.a: Left means what is still there after some are gone. It is a take away clue.
asks: Tell me about the take away words

faq.a: Difference means how much bigger one number is than another. You find it by taking the smaller number from the bigger one. The difference between 7 and 3 is 4.
asks: How do I find the difference?

faq.a: Usually, but not always. Picture the story too. Ask: is it getting more, or fewer?

faq.q: How can I remember the clue words?
faq.a: Make two cards, an add card and a take away card, with the words and a little picture. A teacher or grown-up can help you stick them on your desk.
asks: How do I learn maths words?

facts: Altogether, in total, plus and sum are clue words for adding.
Left, minus, fewer and take away are clue words for taking away.

quiz.say: Read the words. Which word is a clue to add?
quiz.show: Which word is a clue to add?
quiz.why: Altogether means all the things added up.

wrong.0: Left is a clue to take away.

quiz.say: There are 7 birds. 3 birds fly away. How many birds are left?
quiz.show: 🐦 7 birds. 3 fly away. How many are left?
quiz.why: Some birds fly away, so you take away. 7 take away 3 is 4.

wrong.0: 3 is how many birds flew away.
